option_help.--acceptance: Soperator acceptance: readiness or full. Terminal omission prompts after readiness; unattended omission runs full. Ctrl+G finishes extended tests safely.
option_help.--cancel-job: Slurm job id to cancel; repeatable. Required with --job-policy cancel-selected.
option_help.--drain-timeout: Node drain timeout: auto, none, or a Go-style duration such as 30m.
option_help.--dry-run: Explicit read-only planning mode. Resolves the requested official release and validates live cluster, release, capability, and protected-state identity without cloud or Kubernetes mutation.
option_help.--interactive: Prompt for upgrade targets and additional protected jail folders when running from a terminal.
option_help.--job-policy: Slurm job policy: interactive, wait-to-finish, wait-then-cancel, cancel-selected, cancel-all, requeue-selected, requeue-all, requeue-hold-selected, or requeue-hold-all. The wizard first displays the required pause-all-active Partition Policy. Default: requeue-hold-all in both the wizard and non-interactive execution. That policy requeues and holds eligible active batch jobs, reports and waits for jobs that cannot be safely requeued, and never cancels implicitly. Select interactive explicitly for human per-job decisions in the TUI. Automation may pass an explicit --job-policy <policy>.
option_help.--job-refresh-interval: Refresh interval while waiting for Slurm jobs.
option_help.--job-wait-timeout: Maximum wait for Slurm jobs, for example 2h; 0s means unlimited for --job-policy wait-to-finish. wait-then-cancel requires a positive timeout.
option_help.--node-group-gpu-stack-preset: Per-group Nebius GPU stack override as GROUP=PRESET; repeatable.
option_help.--node-group-os: Per-group OS override as GROUP=OS; repeatable.
option_help.--node-group-strategy: Node rollout strategy: zero-surge (default), safe-surge, or force-delete.
option_help.--requeue-job: Slurm job id to requeue; repeatable. Required with --job-policy requeue-selected or requeue-hold-selected.
option_help.--strategy-max-surge-count: Positive temporary node count per group; only valid with safe-surge; defaults to 1.
option_help.--target: cxcli target ref for apps:soperator@<target>. Omit only when one Soperator target is configured or interactive prompting is allowed.
option_help.--to-gpu-stack-preset: Target Nebius-image drivers preset: auto, keep, or an exact provider value. This is not an exact NVIDIA driver build. Operator-managed/driverless groups remain driverless. Required with --no-interactive.
option_help.--to-k8s-version: Target Kubernetes endpoint: latest or exact major.minor. latest is resolved dynamically from the Nebius control-plane version API and frozen with every required sequential minor hop. Required with --no-interactive.
option_help.--to-os: Target node OS: auto, keep, or an exact provider-supported image. Required with --no-interactive.
option_help.--to-release: Target official upstream release: latest or exact X.Y.Z. Interactive omission prompts with latest(<resolved-version>). A fresh --no-interactive upgrade requires this option. Recover an interrupted deployment with deploy CONFIG_YAML.

upgrade.short_help: Select upgrade targets and deploy them through the common workflow.

soperator.group_help: Manage cxcli-owned and pre-existing Soperator clusters through one command surface. Create role-separated MK8s/SFS configuration with `soperator create`, then use render and deploy; inspect an existing MK8s cluster without config through `soperator discover`; existing supported products enter through adoption-only `soperator onboard`. The registered target selects the infrastructure backend. Create and upgrade freeze an exact official upstream release; upgrade also freezes the dynamic Nebius Kubernetes path, node OS/GPU driver compatibility, and Jail CUDA target into one end-to-end campaign. Destroy removes one exact cluster only after protected-storage proof.
